spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Hired, paid, maintained.
2 Cherished, supported.
3

Having, being possessed of, or endowed with.
m. (-तः)
1 A servant.
2 A hired labourer.
E.
भृ to nourish, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 A hired labourer.
2 A servant.
E.
भृत hired, कन् added.

m. (-कः)
A hired teacher, one who gives instructions for pay.
E.
भृतक, and अध्यापक a teacher.

m. (-तः)
A student who pays his teacher.
E.
भृतक, and अध्यापित instructed.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
1 Prosperous, powerful, exalted.
2 Smeared with ashes.
E.
भृत possessed, and भूति power, &c.

mfn. (-न्ध्रः-न्ध्रा-न्ध्रं)
Filled up, (as a hole or depression.)
E.
भृत, and रन्ध्र a hole.

f. (-तिः)
1 Wages, hire.
2 Capital, principal.
3 Nourishment, maintenance.
E.
भृ to nourish, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-भुक्)
A hired labourer or servant.
E.
भृति hire, भुज् to eat, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
To be nourished or maintained.
m. (-त्यः)
1 A dependant.
2 A servant, a slave.
f. (-त्या)
Hire, wages.
E.
भृ to nourish, aff. क्यप्, with तुक् augment.

n. (-त्वं)
Servitude, service, dependance.
E.
त्व added to the last; also with तल्, भृत्यता.

n. (-नं)
Teaching, (especially the Vedas,) for hire.
E.
भृति, and अध्यापन instructing.

n. (-णं)
Maintaining or cherishing dependants, servants, &c.
E.
भृत्य, and भरण nourishing.

m. (-र्त्ता)
A master of a family taking good care of his dependants.
E.
भृत्य, and भर्त्तृ who nourishes.

n. (-ल्यं)
Kindness to dependants or servants.
E.
भृत्य, and वात्सल्य tenderness.

m. (-शः)
Fixing or planting firmly.
E.
भृत्य, and विनिवेश placing.

f. (-त्तिः)
Maintenance of servants or dependants.
E.
भृत्य, and वृत्ति practice.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Having many servants.
E.
भृत्य, and शालिन् possessing.
